name: Lóequre Búadach

attributes.attribute: an Irish hero in the story of the feast of Briccriu

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lóequre Búadach was a hero of Ireland in one old tale. He is a minor figure in the story of the feast given by Briccriu. Briccriu was a man who loved to stir trouble among the heroes. The tale sets his feast at the fort of the Ulstermen. Lóequre appears among the many guests and warriors of that gathering.

okr.objective: Write down what is told of Lóequre Búadach.
key_results: Briccriu gave a feast in the tale where he appears
okr.evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, 2003.
